IF OBJECT_ID('bronze.OnTimeData_CSV') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.OnTimeData_CSV;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.OnTimeData_CSV
    (
        FL_DATE DATE,
        OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID INT,
        TAIL_NUM VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        ORIGIN VARCHAR(10),
        ORIGIN_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        ORIGIN_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        DEST_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        DEST VARCHAR(10),
        DEST_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        DEST_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        CRS_DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_DELAY FLOAT,
        DEP_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        TAXI_OUT FLOAT,
        WHEELS_ON INT,
        TAXI_IN FLOAT,
        CRS_ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_DELAY FLOAT,
        ARR_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        CANCELLED FLOAT,
        CANCELLATION_CODE VARCHAR(5),
        DIVERTED FLOAT,
        CRS_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        AIR_TIME FLOAT,
        DISTANCE FLOAT,
        CARRIER_DELAY FLOAT,
        WEATHER_DELAY FLOAT,
        NAS_DELAY FLOAT,
        SECURITY_DELAY FLOAT,
        LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY FLOAT
    )  
    WITH (
        LOCATION = '/**',
        DATA_SOURCE = USOnTimeProject_Reporting,   
        FILE_FORMAT = csv_file_format
    );

SELECT TOP(100) * FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV;


IF OBJECT_ID('bronze.OnTimeData_Parquet') IS NOT NULL
    DROP EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.OnTimeData_Parquet;

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE bronze.OnTimeData_Parquet
    (
        FL_DATE DATE,
        OP_UNIQUE_CARRIER VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_AIRLINE_ID INT,
        TAIL_NUM VARCHAR(10),
        OP_CARRIER_FL_NUM INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        ORIGIN_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        ORIGIN VARCHAR(10),
        ORIGIN_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        ORIGIN_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        DEST_AIRPORT_ID INT,
        DEST_AIRPORT_SEQ_ID INT,
        DEST VARCHAR(10),
        DEST_CITY_NAME VARCHAR(50),
        DEST_STATE_ABR VARCHAR(5),
        CRS_DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_TIME INT,
        DEP_DELAY FLOAT,
        DEP_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        TAXI_OUT FLOAT,
        WHEELS_ON INT,
        TAXI_IN FLOAT,
        CRS_ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_TIME INT,
        ARR_DELAY FLOAT,
        ARR_DELAY_NEW FLOAT,
        CANCELLED FLOAT,
        CANCELLATION_CODE VARCHAR(5),
        DIVERTED FLOAT,
        CRS_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        ACTUAL_ELAPSED_TIME FLOAT,
        AIR_TIME FLOAT,
        DISTANCE FLOAT,
        CARRIER_DELAY FLOAT,
        WEATHER_DELAY FLOAT,
        NAS_DELAY FLOAT,
        SECURITY_DELAY FLOAT,
        LATE_AIRCRAFT_DELAY FLOAT
    )  
    WITH (
        LOCATION = '/**',
        DATA_SOURCE = USOnTimeProject_Reporting_Parquet,   
        FILE_FORMAT = parquet_file_format
    );

SELECT count(1)  FROM bronze.OnTimeData_Parquet;

SELECT COUNT(1)  FROM bronze.OnTimeData_CSV;


SELECT top 10*
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK '/*/*.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'USOnTimeProject_Reporting_Parquet',
    FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
) AS data;
